summary: Iteration 8 (IP-based viewer heartbeat + real-time live-duration counter) fully verified. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_viewers.py pass — same IP heartbeat stays at count=1, 3 distinct X-Forwarded-For IPs return count=3, offline channel returns {ok:false, viewer_count:0} with no db.viewer_sessions insert, stale sessions (last_seen 60s ago) are excluded from GET, stream_started_at and stream_ended_at fields present on go-live/go-offline, toggling is_live=false wipes viewer_sessions and sets stream_ended_at, unique compound index (channel_username, viewer_id) exists, list_channels/follow/notifications regressions OK. Frontend (Playwright against preview URL): live-duration-badge renders on /channel/testdj when live+stream_started_at set, live-duration text ticks from 00:04 → 00:07 in 3s (diff=3, exact), POST /api/channels/testdj/view fires immediately on mount and viewer-count updates to 1, dashboard-live-duration renders in Dashboard header and ticks (00:13 → 00:15 in 2.5s), live-duration-badge count is 0 when channel is offline (OFF AIR poster remains), SHARE/FOLLOW/SUBSCRIBE buttons + subscribe-login-cta + crowd chat + past sets + broadcaster sidebar all still render (regression OK).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:143 _hashed_viewer_id falls back to secret='salt' if JWT_SECRET missing; low risk since env is required for auth to work, but consider raising if missing to fail fast.

server.py:132 _client_ip uses only first hop of X-Forwarded-For — trust boundary depends on ingress rewriting the header. Livepeer/ingress should strip client-provided XFF; if not, a viewer could inflate their own count by rotating XFF. Acceptable for MVP but flag for prod hardening.

server.py:147 _active_since_iso uses ISO string comparison for cutoff — works only because both stored last_seen and cutoff use timezone-aware ISO with same format (both from datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()). Any code path writing last_seen without tz suffix would silently break the window. Consider storing as native datetime and comparing datetimes.

Channel.jsx:31,54 two independent 15s intervals (load + heartbeat) — fine, but the load poll re-fetches viewer_count which then overrides the fresher heartbeat-updated count for up to 15s. Minor UX flicker possible; not blocking.

server.py:627 heartbeat writes the count back to channels.viewer_count on every beat (extra write per viewer per 15s). Acceptable at current scale, but for sort-order purposes only — could be moved to a periodic aggregator.
seed_data_creation: Tests toggle testdj is_live on/off transiently and insert/remove ephemeral db.viewer_sessions rows. Final state: testdj is_live=false, viewer_sessions cleaned. No persistent seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 viewer-heartbeat + live-duration is fully green. Reusable pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_viewers.py (uses direct Mongo access via motor for stale-row + index verification). Frontend selectors confirmed: live-duration-badge, live-duration, dashboard-live-duration, viewer-count. Any future test that expects testdj to be live must first POST /api/channels/mine/go-live with is_live=true (this also sets stream_started_at) and reset to false in teardown — the autouse _reset fixture in test_viewers.py demonstrates the pattern.
